question: Should OpenClaw core support a regular Slack member as an active agent identity under this explicit identityMode contract and its listed bot-only feature exclusions?
rationale: This admits user-level Slack events into an agent and grants user-token writes, so implementation correctness alone cannot choose the permanent trust boundary or supported feature subset.

options.title: Sponsor after repair and proof
options.body: Approve the explicit mode in principle, then require both blocking fixes and redacted live Slack identity, authorization, and no-loop evidence before merge.

options.title: Keep Slack bot-only
options.body: Reject member identities in core and keep the linked issue open only if maintainers want a different constrained design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Approve the explicit mode in principle, then require both blocking fixes and redacted live Slack identity, authorization, and no-loop evidence before merge.
